UBBC Tuesday Night Ride

Cincinnati, OH · Over-the-Rhine · Social

UBBC Tuesday Night Ride is a social group ride in Cincinnati, OH. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:15 pm from Washington Park gazebo.

How we know

Queen City Bike's calendar lists the UBBC Tuesday Night Ride for Oct 6, 13, 20 and 27, 2026; the event text says every Tuesday at 6:00 pm from the Washington Park gazebo, roll out 6:15 pm, no one dropped (read Oct 1, 2026).

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual party pace. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @ubbc_cincy the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the UBBC Tuesday Night Ride group ride

A casual ride through city streets and alleys on both sides of the river, then back to a bar for a post-ride drink. No one gets dropped. Red Bike station at 14th and Elm if you need wheels.
